title: Argent

inlines.v: 'ARGENT, noun [Latin argentum; Gr. silver, from white.] 1. The white color in coats of arms, intended to represent silver, or purity, innocence, beauty, or gentleness. 2. adjective Silvery; of a pale white, like silver. 3. adjective Bright. Ask of yonder argent fields above.
